name: landing-hero-page
context: Design a high-impact landing page hero section for a product or service launch. The audience is potential customers arriving from ads, search, or social media who need to understand the value proposition within 5 seconds. Target platforms: desktop, tablet, and mobile. The hero must balance visual impact with fast load time and clear call-to-action hierarchy.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Follow typography.rules.json heading scale for clear visual hierarchy
Apply color.rules.json accent color usage and contrast requirements
Layout must be fully responsive across layout.rules.json breakpoints
CTA buttons must have minimum 44x44px touch target on mobile
Images and illustrations must reference Design_Asset_Package by asset ID
Motion must use Motion_Library presets for entrance animations
Comply with Quality_Gate: proper heading hierarchy (h1 first), no decorative-only content without alt text

outputCriteria.format: Page section spec with component tree, token mappings, responsive behavior, and motion choreography
qualityChecks: Single h1 heading present with clear value proposition
CTA has sufficient contrast and prominent visual weight
Responsive layout adapts gracefully at all defined breakpoints
Motion uses declared presets from Motion_Library, not custom durations
accessibilityRequirements: Hero heading is h1 and conveys the primary message
All images have meaningful alt text or are marked decorative
CTA button text describes the action (not generic 'Click here')
Focus order follows visual reading order
Animations respect prefers-reduced-motion via Motion_Library reduce-motion mode

examples.description: Product launch hero section with headline, subtext, CTA, and hero illustration
examples.output:
Section: HeroSection
  Layout: flex(direction=column @mobile, row @desktop), gap: var(--space-xl)
  bg: var(--color-surface-primary)
  padding: var(--space-2xl) var(--space-lg)
  Children:
    - Organism: HeroContent
        - Atom: Heading(level=h1, token=typography.display.lg, color=color.text.primary)
            text: 'Ship faster with confidence'
        - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.lg, color=color.text.secondary)
            text: 'The design system that scales with your product.'
        - Atom: Button(variant=primary, size=lg)
            bg: var(--color-action-primary)
            label: 'Get started free'
            motion: enter-exit.fade-up(delay: 200ms)
    - Atom: Image(assetId=illustration.hero-product, alt='Product dashboard preview')
  Motion: enter-exit.fade-in(stagger: 100ms)
acceptanceCriteria: Uses semantic tokens for all visual properties
CTA uses action color token for prominence
Motion references Motion_Library presets with valid durations
Image references asset by ID from Design_Asset_Package
